steps.say: Open Table adapts tabletop games for different access needs using NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius.
In the workshop, describe an access need and click Ask Nemotron to propose a rule adaptation.
The app sends your need to Nemotron, which proposes concrete changes like adding words and shapes to visual markers.
An independent validator then checks whether the adapted rules preserve the game's strategy across all states.
If the check passes, you can save the adaptation and play with the new rules.
Beacon Steps is a simple race: two players alternate moving a marker one or two spaces.
Player one moves first, advancing two spaces.
Player one advances two spaces again, to five.
Player two advances two spaces, landing exactly on seven.
Seven wins the game. The app confirms the outcome.
Each presentation of the rules is verified to preserve the game across all fourteen reachable states.
Open Table lets people play together in the way that works for them. Thanks for watching.
